assertions.noLastingHarness: no harness process is started; detection is filesystem-only

methodNotes.ownerListener: one owner scenario runs `campfire onboard` (scripted) and then `campfire serve --port 0`; every invitation is a real single-use v1.22.0 invitation issued against that loopback listener. The listener is stopped with SIGINT before scenarios are destroyed.
methodNotes.sharedRecipient: D12–D17 share one recipient scenario joined with a fresh invitation by D12; each case still asserts its own surface. All other D cases use a fresh recipient scenario.
methodNotes.pty: python3 pty, 24x100, child session leader with controlling pty; stderr shares the terminal stream; D2 exits on its own; D17 waits for the `[campfire] remote workspace` line, then sends a real SIGINT (\u0003) after a 300 ms delay
methodNotes.piped: spawnSync with piped stdin/stdout/stderr; no terminal anywhere
methodNotes.daemon: detached child; SIGINT to its process group; stderr/stdout collected
methodNotes.joinOutputMode: `campfire join` piped resolves to JSON unless --output human is passed; the human receipt is the same string in a terminal or with explicit --output human (src/cli/index.ts:2102)
methodNotes.participantCounts: each successful join adds a new human/agent pair to the workspace and joins do not dedupe by name, so D14/D15 observe 5 humans / 5 agents = owner Ada+Codex plus the Ben+codex pairs from D2, D3, D4, and the shared D12 join. The count is deterministic for the fixed case order and is re-asserted on every run.
methodNotes.expiryCheck: the expiry check is client-side before the claim (src/bootstrap/enrollment-client.ts:175), so D6 cannot consume the invitation
methodNotes.permissionMessage: D10: the intended `Enrollment file must be a bounded private file` failure (src/bootstrap/enrollment-client.ts:35) throws inside the try and is re-wrapped by the catch at :38, so v1.22.0 reports the generic `Enrollment file is missing or invalid; use the original private file` for non-private modes as well
methodNotes.ownerStderr: the owner listener prints its own authz lines; they are not captured as evidence. A `{"allow":false,...,"method":"whoami"}` line can appear on the owner listener stderr during recipient activity; it is recorded in the summary observations, not asserted.
methodNotes.ttyDetection: non-TTY stdout suppresses the browser branch (`up` piped records openedBrowser:false without --no-open); D17 additionally passes --no-open so no browser can launch from a terminal

maskingRules: see BASELINE_PIN.md — cft-shaped credential tokens -> [redacted]; cfe-shaped invitation secrets -> [one-time-credential: redacted]; enrollment invitation ids (ein_inv_<16 hex>) -> ein_inv_[id]; absolute /Users, /private, /var/folders, /tmp paths -> [path]; loopback ports -> [port]; ISO timestamps -> [timestamp]; UUIDs -> [uuid]; object ids (<prefix>_<16 hex>) -> <prefix>_[id]
